caption: the cartoon law as a game - set traps, spring traps, chase the cheese through the house.
about: Tom and jerry in house trap (2000) turns the cartoon's whole grammar into a trap-warfare brawler: tom and jerry raid the pantry setting spring-loaded traps on each other, two players make it a proper versus game, and the house's rooms are the levels. It is the most faithful tom-and-jerry game mechanics ever got.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps1 - played through duckstation, rom sourced from romsfun.
